description: This file defines the GrainClassMap class, which manages the mapping between GrainType identifiers and their corresponding Type objects within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for initializing the map and retrieving grain class types based on grain type identifiers, handling generic types as well.

classes.name: GrainClassMap
classes.description: A class that maintains a mapping between GrainType identifiers and their corresponding .NET Type objects, supporting retrieval of grain class types, including generic types.

methods.name: GrainClassMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GrainClassMap with a TypeConverter and a dictionary of GrainType to Type mappings.

methods.name: TryGetGrainClass
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the Type of a grain class corresponding to a given GrainType, handling generic types and returning a boolean indicating success.
